## Summary

- **Fix `ordinal()` bug** (`meechie-tool.adapter.ts`): lineup items ≥ 21 were getting wrong English suffixes (`21th`, `22th`, `23th`). Now uses proper modulo logic with the 11–13 edge-case guard so all ordinals are correct.
- **Extract duplicate provider-error block** (`meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts`): two near-identical 13-line `PROVIDER_API_KEY_MISSING` error-handling blocks collapsed into a single `buildProviderError()` helper; each call site is now a one-liner.
- **Fix null-ambiguity in image response parsing** (`generate-pipeline.ts`): replaced `.catch(() => null)` sentinel with an explicit `try/catch` so a JSON parse failure can never be confused with a response body that is the literal JSON value `null`.
- **Eliminate double `Number()` call** (`app-config-seam/index.ts`): `MAX_IMAGES_PER_REQUEST` was parsed twice on the same line. Extracted a `parseOptionalInt()` helper that parses once and returns `undefined` on `NaN`.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (svelte-check + TypeScript) — confirmed locally before pushing
- [ ] Verify lineup tool renders `21st`, `22nd`, `23rd`, `111th` correctly if you have ≥ 21 items
- [ ] Smoke-test studio text generation (calls `meechie-studio-text-pipeline`) — both first-attempt and retry paths should still return errors unchanged
- [ ] Verify `MAX_IMAGES_PER_REQUEST` env var still parses correctly (set to `"3"` and confirm the config reads `3`)

Refine text and image pipeline behavior and configuration parsing while fixing ordinal formatting.

Bug Fixes:
- Correct lineup ordinal suffix generation for all item positions.
- Prevent JSON parse failures in image generation responses from being misinterpreted as literal null payloads.
- Ensure environment-derived maxImagesPerRequest values are parsed once and treated as undefined when non-numeric.

Enhancements:
- Deduplicate provider API key error handling in the studio text pipeline via a shared helper.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces several improvements, including extracting a reusable `buildProviderError` helper in the text pipeline, refactoring JSON parsing in the generate pipeline, and correcting the `ordinal` formatting logic for numbers ending in 11, 12, and 13. Additionally, a `parseOptionalInt` helper was added to parse environment variables. However, a review comment points out that `parseOptionalInt` uses `Number()`, which can lead to unexpected behavior for whitespace-only strings or floats, and suggests using `parseInt` with a trim check instead.

Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- In `parseOptionalInt`, consider using `parseInt` (or explicitly validating integer-ness) instead of `Number` so the helper aligns with its name and avoids silently accepting non-integer numeric strings.
